# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is described with long gray hair framing a placid face. He rarely dresses up with a white collar and drives in a buggy.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Matthew is an extremely shy, quiet, and taciturn man who hates being among strangers or having to speak. Despite his reserved nature, he is deeply soft-hearted, indulgent, kind, and sympathetic. He is considered odd by some due to his silent demeanour and tendency to take Anne's part or listen to her attentively.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c10 P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c25 P13](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0013), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_

- extremely shy  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert resided at Green Gables, an orchard-embowered homestead in Avonlea built by his shy father. Never known to volunteer information, he led a quiet life away from most people until he drove out to collect young Anne Shirley, who found him to be a kindred spirit. Throughout her stay at Green Gables, Matthew delighted in listening to Anne and frequently took her side. One morning, after reading a newspaper account of the Abbey Bank failure, he suffered a sudden shock and died instantaneously. He was buried near the fields and orchards he loved, and Anne faithfully made weekly visits to his grave to honor his memory.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P16](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0016), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c10 P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_
